name: led
description: PWM LED driver with on/off, brightness, blink, fade, and breathe effects. Defaults to 500Hz PWM with 1023 max duty (ESP32). Supports inverted logic via is_0_max flag.

constructor_params.name: pin
constructor_params.description: machine.Pin instance or GPIO number (must support PWM)

constructor_params.name: is_0_max
constructor_params.description: Inverted logic. False: duty=1023 brightest (default ESP32). True: duty=0 brightest (some external drivers).

properties.name: brightness
properties.description: Current brightness 0~1023. Setting updates PWM immediately.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Turn LED on at current brightness

methods.name: set_brightness
methods.description: Set brightness 0~1023 (alias for brightness property setter)

methods.name: blink
methods.description: Blink on/off `times` times with `interval` ms between transitions (uses time.sleep_ms)

methods.name: fade_to
methods.description: Smoothly transition to target brightness over `steps` iterations

methods.name: fade_on
methods.description: Fade in from 0 to current remembered brightness

methods.name: fade_off
methods.description: Fade out from current brightness to 0

methods.name: test
methods.description: Interactive test: prompts for pin, then runs all features in sequence

example:
from machine import Pin
from led import LED

led = LED(Pin(4))
led.brightness = 800
led.on()
import time
time.sleep(2)
led.fade_off()
led.blink(times=3, interval=300)
esp32_notes: PWM frequency is hardcoded to 500Hz at init — not user-configurable in v1.0
Max duty is 1023 (10-bit). On ESP32-S2/S3/C3 this is also 10-bit. On RP2040, set is_0_max appropriately if ported.
PWM on GPIO 34-39 fails (input-only pins) — constructor raises RuntimeError
fade_to uses integer division — large steps may produce non-uniform transitions
All timing uses time.sleep_ms() — NOT non-blocking. Do not call from ISR.
hardware_notes: Default wiring: LED anode → GPIO via current-limiting resistor (~220Ω) → GND
For common-anode RGB LED strips, use is_0_max=True
Total GPIO current should stay < 100mA across all pins
differences_from_standard_mp: Standard MicroPython requires manual PWM setup: pwm = PWM(Pin(4), freq=500); pwm.duty(512). NovaMP LED wraps this.
LED includes fade and breathe effects — standard code requires custom math
brightness setter auto-updates PWM — standard code requires pwm.duty() after each change
